title: feat(p4sel): cov4>0 iff wt1=1 or adj2=1
science: Exact closed form: cov4(f)>0 iff (wt1=1 OR adj2=1), unique match on all 32 maps (N_pos=24, tp=24 tn=8 fp=fn=0). The eight cov4=0 maps are exactly wt1=0 AND adj2=0. Together with #6516 (k=1: wt1 AND adj2) and #6494 (k=2: wt1 AND (adj2 or vertex3 or mixed3)) this gives a seed-size-dependent family of exact selectors.
